ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-gray to 25% low-intensity black, localized primarily at the margins and central peduncle insertion.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones occupying the central fluke lobes, bifurcated by a low-intensity black vertical wedge. Multiple discrete low-intensity circular pixel clusters (spots) are distributed bilaterally: five on the left lobe and three on the right lobe. Yellow-brown pixel hue shift observed in the upper interior quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees and a depth reaching approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire margin. Amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline. Notable jagged protrusion at the far left tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetry showing a concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to a convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast cluster of white/brownish textured pixels on the superior-most point of the left fluke tip, indicating barnacle colonization. Similar smaller clusters visible on the superior right fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Horizontal low-intensity linear disruption on the lower left lobe. Two distinct parallel curved linear marks on the mid-right lobe (rake marks).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized mass of barnacles and associated tissue trauma on the outer-upper margin of the left fluke lobe. Visible linear scarring (rake marks) on the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial arrangement of four dark spots on the left lobe forming a trapezoidal pattern. Ochre-toned staining localized to the inner white pigmentation of both lobes.
